description: Get a live quote for staking N whole STANDARD tokens into a new The Standard Reserve (TSR) S-Bill, on Robinhood Chain: the rate you would lock, the premium escrowed for you, and the rate after your deposit, read straight from the contract rather than from indexed state. Also reports whether caps, minimum deposit, pause, or budget would currently block the deposit, and exit_fee_estimate: an estimate of the early-exit fee if you left right after depositing, checked against live quotes. An early exit returns principal minus that fee; the premium and any stayer bonus are never paid out early. Rates are per term, not annual. amount is whole STANDARD tokens (not wei), as a decimal string. Pass wallet to also check the deposit against that wallet's open principal and its headroom under the per-wallet cap.

amount.description: Whole STANDARD tokens to stake, as a decimal string (not wei), up to 18 decimal places.

wallet.description: Optional 0x wallet address. Adds its open principal and cap headroom to checks.
